usage: Used to refer to knowledge or skill gained through doing something
Often used to describe past work, life events, or practice
Commonly paired with 有 / 冇 / 累積 to talk about amount of experience
Can refer to both personal experiences and professional background

examples.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 hou2 do1 gung1 zok3 ging1 jim6
examples.meaning: He has a lot of work experience.

examples.sentence: 呢次經驗令我學到好多嘢。
examples.jyutping: ni1 ci3 ging1 jim6 ling6 ngo5 hok6 dou3 hou2 do1 je5
examples.meaning: This experience taught me a lot.
